place.summary: Man Mo Temple functions primarily as a connector in Hong Kong's visitor network. Its strongest observed source market is TH. It receives notable inbound connections from Sha Tin Che Kung Temple. Visitors often continue to Sha Tin Che Kung Temple. Its observed experience trails the category average, despite existing visitor demand.
